title: FlashSystem.ai
items: An assistant in the management GUI that retrieves information and completes supported tasks from plain-language requests
FlashSystem.ai 是 Management GUI 中的助理，可用自然語言查詢系統資訊並執行支援的設定工作。
When does FlashSystem.ai change the system?
助理會詢問所需資訊，且只在使用者明確核准後才變更系統。
Which deployment modes does FlashSystem.ai support from release 9.2.0?
自 9.2.0 起支援 internal 與 disabled 兩種部署模式。
How does FlashSystem.ai base its answers on accurate information?
It uses retrieval techniques on IBM FlashSystem product documentation
助理使用檢索技術，以 IBM FlashSystem 產品文件為依據回答。
Which language is the default for FlashSystem.ai?
FlashSystem.ai 預設語言為英文，也可用其他支援語言下指令或查詢。
Which of these languages is supported by FlashSystem.ai?
支援英文、西班牙文、法文、德文、葡萄牙文、義大利文、荷蘭文、俄文、簡繁中文、日文與韓文。
On which minimum version is the FlashSystem.ai interface available?
FlashSystem.ai 介面僅在 9.1.2.1 以上的系統提供。
An active IBM Storage Insights connection with an API key and tenant ID
需要有效的 IBM Storage Insights 連線，使用 API Key 與 Tenant ID。
Which administrative action is supported by FlashSystem.ai?
Create volumes and attach them to hosts
支援建立 Volume 並連接 Host、建立 Host 與 Host Cluster、Volume Group、Snapshot，以及更名或擴充 Volume 等。
Which policy-related action can FlashSystem.ai perform?
Modify snapshot and replication policies on volume groups
可指派或修改 Volume Group 的 Snapshot 與 Replication Policy，但不能移除 Policy 或建立 Replication Policy。
Pools, partitions, portsets, and host-volume mappings
可查詢系統概觀、Volume、Host、Mapping、Snapshot、Policy、Pool、Partition 與 Portset。
Is filtering and aggregation supported for FlashSystem.ai query results?
所有查詢結果都支援篩選與彙總。
By default, from which system does the assistant retrieve data when you request a list of volumes?
預設從目前作用中的系統取資料，也可指定其他已設定系統的名稱。
Which service does FlashSystem.ai integrate with for workload placement recommendations?
FlashSystem.ai 整合 IBM Storage Insights，以全機隊分析、歷史效能與容量預測提供 Workload Placement 建議。
Which inputs can you describe to get workload placement recommendations?
Capacity, IOPS and latency, read/write patterns, block sizes, and snapshot requirements
需以自然語言描述容量、IOPS 與 Latency、讀寫模式、Block Size 與 Snapshot 需求。
What happens to an ongoing workload placement analysis if you start a new chat session?
分析期間無法互動，開始新的對話會取消進行中的分析。
What do proactive AI-initiated notifications present at sign-in?
系統監控儲存與 Storage Insights 的資安、合規與容量問題，於登入時在助理中提出可執行的通知。
How many high-priority notifications are displayed at a time?
一次最多顯示三則高優先通知。
How do you view and unmute muted notification categories?
輸入 /unmute 可檢視並取消靜音的通知類別。
What is required to enable email notifications for proactive alerts?
The tenant administrator email ID configured in IBM Storage Insights
An SMTP server on each host
要啟用 Email 通知，需在 IBM Storage Insights 設定 Tenant Administrator 的 Email ID。
How does FlashSystem.ai present each create or modify operation?
With a human-readable confirmation dialog that explains the action in plain language
每次執行前都會顯示淺顯文字的確認對話框，需明確核准。
Where are FlashSystem.ai configuration changes executed?
Through on-premises API calls; nothing is executed in the cloud
所有變更透過地端 API 呼叫執行，不在雲端執行。
Which operation is blocked by FlashSystem.ai guardrails?
Guardrails 阻擋刪除物件、縮小物件、反轉 Replication、從 Snapshot Restore、移除 Policy 與資安相關工作。
Can FlashSystem.ai restore data from snapshots?
從 Snapshot Restore 屬於被 Guardrails 阻擋的操作。
Can FlashSystem.ai create partitions or replication policies?
No, objects that require special handling are blocked
建立需特殊處理的物件 (例如 Partition、Replication Policy) 不受支援。
Does FlashSystem.ai have access to security-related information on the system?
助理無法存取系統的任何資安相關資訊。
Which item is included in each FlashSystem.ai audit record?
The client IP address used to log in
Audit 記錄包含使用者名稱、登入 Client IP、操作細節與 FlashSystem.ai 操作識別碼。
簡報 S5；Concept Guide Ch23 Audit logging
For operations on remote grid members, where is the audit record stored?
In the audit log of the target system, with the originating system identifier
對遠端 Grid 成員的操作記錄在目標系統的 Audit Log，並含來源系統識別碼。
What are the two categories of FlashSystem.ai shared memory?
Shared Memory 分為 Semantic Memory (使用者明確提供的事實) 與 Inferred Memory (由過往互動推得的模式)。
When semantic and inferred memory conflict, which takes precedence?
資訊衝突時 Semantic Memory 優先並覆寫 Inferred Memory。
How can external AI platforms integrate with FlashSystem.ai?
Through a REST API, using a SKILL.md file available on GitHub
可透過 REST API 與外部 AI 平台整合，GitHub 提供 SKILL.md 檔案，且套用相同的規劃、Guardrails 與核准控制。
What is required for FlashSystem.ai to create IBM Support cases?
A registered IBM Support email address and connectivity to esupport.ibm.com
建立 Support Case 需要已註冊的 IBM Support Email 與到 esupport.ibm.com 的網路連線。
Concept Guide Ch23 IBM Support case creation
What does FlashSystem.ai upload when it creates a support case?
A support package with standard logs and a new state save
建立 Case 時會上傳含 Standard Logs 與新 State Save 的 Support Package。
In a FlashSystem grid, who can create support cases for members that do not run FlashSystem.ai?
Grid Coordinator 可為未執行 FlashSystem.ai 的成員系統建立 Support Case。
What account must be created on each system for FlashSystem.ai?
A dedicated Administrator account, provisioned manually by the customer
每個系統須由客戶手動建立專用的 Administrator 帳號。
Who registers each system for FlashSystem.ai with chaicontainerinfo?
需由 Security Administrator 以 `chaicontainerinfo` 註冊每個系統。
Included at no additional cost; no watsonx.ai subscription required
FlashSystem.ai 隨系統免費提供，不需 watsonx.ai 訂閱。
What should you do with responses generated by FlashSystem.ai for critical information?
Review and verify them before acting
生成的回應可能不準確或不完整，關鍵資訊應先檢查與驗證再採取行動。
In internal mode, how are management operations on the local system performed?
Using the CLI, with FlashSystem.ai embedded and running locally
internal 模式內嵌於 FlashSystem 本機執行，管理操作使用 CLI，不需外部 Container。
In internal mode, what can a FlashSystem grid member running FlashSystem.ai do?
Manage other systems in the same grid
同一 Grid 中執行 FlashSystem.ai 的系統可管理其他成員。
What happens in the GUI when FlashSystem.ai is in disabled mode?
The chat icon is not displayed
disabled 模式關閉 AI 服務，GUI 不顯示聊天圖示。
Where in the GUI do you view and update FlashSystem.ai settings?
於 Management GUI 的 Settings > FlashSystem.ai 檢視與更新設定。
Do Kubernetes or OpenShift container deployments migrate automatically to internal mode?
No; change the mode with chaicontainerinfo and verify with lsaicontainerinfo
由 Kubernetes 或 OpenShift Container 部署的不會自動遷移；以 `chaicontainerinfo` 變更模式，再以 `lsaicontainerinfo` 驗證。
How many administrator service accounts are required per FlashSystem system?
前置需求之一是每個 FlashSystem 系統有一個 Administrator Service Account。
Where do you obtain the Storage Insights REST API key?
Storage Insights Settings > User access management > Manage REST API key access
在 Storage Insights 的 Settings > User access management > Manage REST API key access 建立並複製 API Key。
Concept Guide Ch23 Obtaining IBM Storage Insights credentials
For multi-step requests, what does FlashSystem.ai display?
多步驟請求會顯示計畫與進度更新，結果可用支援篩選與彙總的表格呈現。
What happens to notifications if no action is taken?
They continue to appear in later sessions until addressed or replaced by higher-priority ones
未處理的通知會在之後的對話持續出現，直到處理完成或被更高優先通知取代。
Which prerequisite may be needed for outbound communication by FlashSystem.ai?
若需要對外通訊，須設定 Proxy；另需可連到 Storage Insights 的網路。
反轉 Replication Relationship 屬被 Guardrails 阻擋的操作。
What does selecting an action on a proactive notification do?
It removes all other notifications from the view
選擇處理某則通知後，其他通知會從畫面移除。
